audit.whatIsWrong: The entire full layer tracks a fabricated ability called 'Repeating Dashes'. Ambessa has no such ability.
audit.why: Her real kit is Drakehound's Step (P, the dash you get by queuing a move/attack command during a cast, which also empowers her next attack), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q, 14s at rank 1), Repudiation (W, 18s, shield that braces and hits harder if it blocked non-minion damage), Lacerate (E, 13s, dash and slow) and Public Execution (R, 130s, blink, suppress, stun). The content layer already uses the correct names; the full layer never does.
audit.corrected: Replaced the fake name with Lacerate, Repudiation, Drakehound's Step and Public Execution in tldr, dosFull, dontsFull, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and phases[4].why, with the real cooldowns attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers carry [Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank, Skill, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank] while the packet chart and their own why text say [Gangplank, Skill, Skill, Gangplank, Ambessa, Ambessa, Gangplank].
audit.why: whys[0] says the level-1 chip pays you gold and her recasts cannot punish it (Gangplank). whys[1] literally opens 'Even window' and whys[2] says it comes down to who respects the cooldown (Skill, Skill). whys[3] is your best laning window (Gangplank). whys[4] opens 'Her spike' and whys[5] says she out-trades you at first item (Ambessa, Ambessa). Six rows are wrong in both layers and the packet agrees with the prose on every one.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 flipped in both layers as one atomic group, with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes and phases[4].why describe a level-6 spike that belongs to nobody in particular and never name the ultimate.
audit.why: The spikes are: her level-6 Public Execution (130/115/100s) with the double-dash combo, which out-trades your raw stats before your keg build exists, and your Essence Reaver / keg-chain window at two items, which she does not reclaim because she is a fighter, not a hyperscaler. Cannon Barrage at 160s zones but does not win the duel.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names Public Execution and its 130s cooldown and states why the row belongs to her.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers and pointed at the fabricated ability.
audit.why: The countable windows are Lacerate 13s, Repudiation 18s, Cunning Sweep 14s, Public Execution 130s and your Cannon Barrage 160s.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the four real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four separate strings assert that Remove Scurvy cannot break Public Execution's suppression.
audit.why: Riot's Remove Scurvy text is only 'cure crowd control effects' and the kit files carry no suppression-eligibility data — the mirror audit flagged the same claim. It may well be true, but it is not sourceable from the material I have.
audit.corrected: Left every instance untouched and avoided repeating it in any new string; logged as unverified.

edits.after: Poke her with kegs, Remove Scurvy the Lacerate slow, out-scale. Fight once her dash is spent.
